snapshot.text: Well-funded public system run through Hamad Medical Corporation and primary care centres, guided by the National Health Strategy 2024–2030. The government seeks more private-sector participation.

priorities.title: Private sector partnership
priorities.text: The health minister and the Qatari Businessmen Association discussed more private-sector delivery of care.

priorities.title: Emergency preparedness and primary care
priorities.text: The health minister names emergency preparedness, primary care and innovation as focus areas.

priorities.title: Tuberculosis plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: Preparations started for a national tuberculosis plan.
